meta.title: Skill selector
meta.description: Manual skill mode is enabled by default across this profile. Ordinary messages do not auto-load skills; send a selected draft to load them, or turn the user switch off to restore native behavior. Find all effective skills by task in the current conversation right pane. Use one skill or preview a primary/helper combination. Retains ratings, notes, favorites, hidden skills and all historical records. Combined reviews do not affect individual scores. Compare in your own conversation branches; there is no dedicated comparison workflow. Includes full YouMind and original Cookbook and PromptFill sites, opened in new Chrome windows after selection. Hiding never deletes or globally disables skills.
